tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description: Search the merchant catalog for a product by name and return the matching products (authoritative NOT_FOUND when absent)

args.name: product
args.description: Product name or query to search for

tools.name: selectProduct
tools.description: Select a product the customer picked (by id or by name) and make it the active product

tools.name: getProductDetails
tools.description: Return full details (description, price, currency, stock status, category) for a product

args.name: productName
args.description: Product name to fetch details for

args.name: productId
args.description: Product id to fetch details for

tools.name: suggestProducts
tools.description: Recommend products matching the customer preferences, reranking catalog candidates

tools.name: calculateShipping
tools.description: Look up the delivery cost configured for a wilaya for this merchant

args.name: wilaya
args.description: Wilaya (name or number) to calculate shipping for

tools.name: getOrderStatus
tools.description: Return the status and tracking number of an order by its id

args.name: orderId
args.description: Order id to check the status of

tools.name: createOrder
tools.description: Create a new pending order (explicit product id, delivery wilaya, commune, quantity), compute the total with delivery cost, and flag it as waiting for confirmation

tools.name: confirmOrder
tools.description: Confirm an order by its id

tools.name: modifyOrder
tools.description: Update an order's quantity, wilaya, or commune by its id and recompute the total

tools.name: cancelOrder
tools.description: Cancel an order by its id

tools.name: escalateConversation
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human agent with a reason (idempotent)

args.name: reason
args.description: Reason the customer needs a human agent
